anom.verdict_arkansas_june.definition: verdict from the two claims above
anom.verdict_arkansas_june.value: Refuted: Arkansas has 2 Class G fires in 29 years and none in June. June is the peak Class G month for Arizona and Alaska; the README most likely mislabels AZ or AK as AR.

anom.verdict_northeast_2010.definition: verdict from the Northeast claims above
anom.verdict_northeast_2010.value: Not reproduced with this region definition: 2010 has z = 0.98 on fires and z = 0.48 on acres, ranking 7 of 29 years by fires. The series is dominated by reporting shifts (largest jumps in 2020, 2005, 2015) and by states with zero-record years.

anom.verdict_texas_december.definition: verdict from the Texas claims above
anom.verdict_texas_december.value: Not a general pattern: December ranks 10 of 12 Texas months by fires and 10 of 12 by acres. Texas's big-fire season is January to April. One December stands out: 2005 with 94,523 acres, 2.7x the next largest December.

cause.by_classification.definition: fires, acres and shares by NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION

cause.general_cause_share_by_size_class.definition: share of fires in each FIRE_SIZE_CLASS by NWCG_GENERAL_CAUSE (rows sum to 1)

ces.by_owner.definition: Control Efficiency Score = 1 / (acres per hour to containment) aggregated per OWNER_DESCR with the mean (original definition) and the median; acres per hour = FIRE_SIZE / DURATION_HOURS; records of all years with DURATION_HOURS > 0; owners with at least 1,000 such records
ces.by_owner.note: Rank 1 = highest score = fewest acres per hour.

ces.median_aph_by_size_class.definition: median acres per hour by FIRE_SIZE_CLASS, same sample
ces.median_aph_by_size_class.note: Shows that acres per hour is mostly a function of final size, which the score does not control for.

ces.rank_shift.definition: rank under the mean-based score minus rank under the median-based score, per owner
ces.rank_shift.note: A large positive value means the owner looks much worse under the original mean-based score.

ces.spearman_mean_vs_median.definition: Spearman correlation between the two owner rankings

class_g.acres_by_year.definition: sum of FIRE_SIZE for FIRE_SIZE_CLASS == G by FIRE_YEAR

class_g.acres_by_year_west.definition: same, REGION == West (AZ CA CO ID MT NV NM OR UT WA WY) only

class_g.acres_trend.definition: Kendall tau and Theil-Sen slope of Class G acres per year, 1992-2020 (29 annual points; years with no Class G fires count as 0)
class_g.acres_trend.note: Class G is the size class least affected by the reporting caveat: fires of 5,000+ acres are recorded by every reporting system, so this series is the most comparable across years.

class_g.alaska_share_of_acres.definition: Alaska share of all Class G acres 1992-2020

class_g.fires_by_year.definition: count of FIRE_SIZE_CLASS == G by FIRE_YEAR

class_g.fires_trend.definition: Kendall tau and Theil-Sen slope of Class G fire counts per year

class_g.five_lowest_years.definition: the five lowest Class G acre years
class_g.five_lowest_years.note: Tests "higher lows": if a recent year is among the lowest, the lows are not rising.

class_g.half_period_means.definition: mean annual Class G acres in the first 14 and last 15 years

class_g.half_period_means_west.definition: mean annual Class G acres in the West in the first 14 and last 15 years

class_g.west_ratio_by_state.definition: ratio of mean annual Class G acres 2006-2020 to 1992-2005, per Western state

cont.n_by_size_class_and_owner_2010_plus.definition: cell counts behind the previous claim

cont.share_zero_hours_2010_plus.definition: share of that sample with DURATION_HOURS == 0 (containment time equals discovery time)

geo.cells_1deg_file.definition: 1-degree cells: cell_lat/cell_lon = floor(LATITUDE)/floor(LONGITUDE) (south-west corner); n_fires; acres = sum FIRE_SIZE; n_human, n_natural, n_missing_cause from NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION; human_share_known = n_human / (n_human + n_natural); human_share_all = n_human / n_fires

geo.fires_and_acres_by_gacc.definition: fires and acres by state-level GACC approximation (see overview.gacc_definition)

geo.top5_states_acres.definition: five states with the most acres

geo.top5_states_fires.definition: five states with the most fires

overview.gacc_definition.note: Only Northwest (OR WA), Southwest (AZ NM), Great Basin members (ID NV UT WY) and the ten GACC names were verified from gacc.nifc.gov pages fetched 2026-09-25; the rest is unverified.
overview.gacc_definition.value: State-level approximation of the ten NWCG GACCs; whole states assigned to one area, California North/South merged, Idaho and Wyoming not split. Lists: Alaska = AK; Northwest = OR WA; California (North+South merged) = CA; Great Basin (approx) = ID NV UT; Northern Rockies (approx) = MT ND; Rocky Mountain (approx) = CO WY SD NE KS; Southwest = AZ NM; Southern Area (approx) = AL AR FL GA KY LA MS NC OK SC TN TX VA PR; Eastern Area (approx) = CT DE DC IA IL IN ME MD MA MI MN MO NH NJ NY OH PA RI VT WV WI; Hawaii (not a GACC) = HI

overview.missing_cont_date_share_2010_pl.definition: share of records with FIRE_YEAR >= 2010 whose CONT_DATE is null

overview.missing_counts.definition: count of records where the field is null, or (for cause and owner) equals the explicit "Missing data/not specified/undetermined" / "MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED" category

overview.missing_shares.definition: the same counts divided by all rows

overview.n_rows.definition: row count of data/fires.parquet (table Fires of FPA_FOD_20221014.sqlite)

overview.region_definition.value: West = AZ CA CO ID MT NV NM OR UT WA WY; South = AL AR FL GA KY LA MS NC OK SC TN TX VA WV; Northeast = CT ME MA NH RI VT NY NJ PA; Alaska = AK; Hawaii/PR = HI PR; Other = every other STATE value (Midwest, Plains, DC, DE, MD).

overview.size_class_definition.value: FIRE_SIZE_CLASS as coded in FPA FOD: A < 0.26 acres, B 0.26-9.9, C 10-99.9, D 100-299, E 300-999, F 1,000-4,999, G 5,000 and up.

overview.total_acres.definition: sum of FIRE_SIZE over all records
